description: Report the status of one workflow run (by runId) or of all runs, classified against the active profile (current / historical / needs-adaptation / blocked-by-config). Read-only and fail-visible: an unavailable store surfaces a problem row, never an empty result. Takes no lock and mutates nothing.

runId.description: A run id to report on; omit for all runs.

name: workflow_run_status
title: Workflow Run Status
